items.problem: Dependent bootstrap commands and later build/run/validation commands were issued concurrently, causing races and locked intermediate files.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 1-2: bootstrap raced dotnet new and self-check; turns 23-29: concurrent dotnet run/build/validator operations caused restore collisions and a locked XAML input.json.
items.covered_at: SKILL.md Step 0 numbered bootstrap commands; Step 3 'build -> fix -> launch -> repeat' and Build command discipline.
items.proposed_improvement: State explicitly that dependent bootstrap steps and all commands touching one project's build artifacts must be awaited and run serially, never batched or parallelized.
items.generalizes: Scaffold/bootstrap dependencies and MSBuild/NuGet/XAML intermediate-file contention affect all migrations, especially agents optimized to batch tool calls.
